component.name: Notata
component.summary: Tag your media once, and let every server read it

description.p: Notata reads and writes metadata for music, movies, series, comics, and books, using the formats media servers already understand: embedded audio tags, Kodi-style NFO sidecars, and the XML inside CBZ and EPUB archives.
Includes MusicBrainz and cover art lookup for music, TMDB/TheTVDB lookup for movies and series, batch editing, template-based renaming, and duplicate detection.
